question: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word HORIZON (in both forward and backward directions) which have as many letters between them as there are in the English alphabetical order?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66609366b4349e6bc2ec78fccba8ce4c9abb5b69705fcc8f069167745961a60b.png]
